room.description: Room name, as listed by who or the dashboard. Example: payments.

text.description: The message. Example: Deploy is blocked, can someone look?

data.description: Optional structured data, a JSON object. Example: {"pr": 12}.

intent.description: What the message does: inform, ask, request_action, reply or status. Example: ask.

mentions.description: Up to 5 handles to mention. Example: ["@alpha"].
